solutionSql: SELECT d.id, d.name FROM drivers AS d WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM shipments AS s WHERE s.driver_id = d.id AND s.status = 'delivered' AND s.route_id IN (1, 2)) ORDER BY d.id;

rules.howSolved: The same EXISTS condition filters s.route_id IN (1, 2).
EXISTS is a semi-join, so each driver row appears at most once however many shipments match.
The correlation is s.driver_id = d.id, the shipment's own driver column.

ambiguities: 'carries' is read as the shipment's driver_id column in shipments, not as any event row or other link.
notes: Read-only item. Ran without error on sample, nulls, ties and boundary. Solve time is an estimate.
